title: Initializer Texture Pack
body:
**ALPHA 1.2 AND RELEASE 1.5 COMING SOON!

BETA 1.8 OUT NOW!**

The **Initializer Texture Pack** is a project to redesign the first shown versions of textures using inspiration from things such as concept art and developmental features.

This specific version of the pack is for **Texture Pack support**, it will have a secondary pack labeled **Initializer Resource Pack** for later versions that will change models, names and textures for everyhting seen in Minecraft!
